title: Uwell Viscore Watermelon Strawberry Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Watermelon Strawberry combines the juicy freshness of watermelon with the summery sweetness of ripe strawberries, delivering a smooth and satisfying vape. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for extended value and convenience. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures bold flavour and smooth vapour production, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. The refill container makes topping up simple and mess-free, offering up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it an excellent choice for adult vapers seeking a premium vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the sweet and refreshing Watermelon Strawberry flavour.
